name: vox-desktop
description: Vox desktop companion with secure local Codex and smart-home bridges
author: Vox

scripts.check: node scripts/check.mjs && node --test scripts/computer-use-session.test.mjs scripts/local-web-server.test.mjs scripts/dyson-local.test.mjs scripts/smart-home-hub.test.mjs scripts/voice-filter.test.mjs scripts/welcome-home.test.mjs && node scripts/personal-api.test.mjs && node scripts/personal-route.test.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run voice-models && npm run beacon && npm run prepare:web && electron-builder
